title: One domain's census, run end to end on the deterministic route, is measured against the sprint-1 baseline in model-read rows, tokens, USD and wall time
goal: A census of one domain chosen by its source count (census.py run with a topic or directory selection, then groups, judge, dispatch, apply, finish and the phase-4 sample) runs after a --dry-run whose estimated tokens and USD set the run's --max-budget-usd; kb/_self/reports/fact-diff.md gains a section with, for that domain, the rows handed to a model, the facts judged by the batch call and by agent groups, tokens, USD, wall time per phase from the census.phase ops rows, and the phase-4 sample's agreement, set against the same domain's share of the 2026-09-26 census as the queue block measured it, with the commands that produced each figure; a kb/_self/_retrieval/lookup_eval.csv row asks what a census of a domain costs on this route and packs good to that section; a sample disagreement is filed as a bug of the step that caused it, not fixed in this story.

gates.question: census.py run takes no topic or directory selection (its steps cover the whole root, and its fact diff alone is about 30 minutes and 3,000 sources); how is the logs domain's phase 0-1 run?
options: the steps of census.plan_run one by one on the domain: factdiff.py detect --dir logs --sitemaps, apply --commit, census.py check --source <each logs source id> --factdiff, repin, build_index.py, the phase-1 commit, summary
census.py run on the whole root, then the logs rows read

notes: The domain is picked at the sprint's planning by the research story (a mid-sized domain with Learn, live and pinned sources, such as entra, which fact-diff.md's dry run already measured); its article glob (kb/public/<domain>/**) is then added to touches with backlog.py set --add-touch before the start, since phase 2 edits articles. This is a paid run: a --dry-run estimate first, and --max-budget-usd from it (planning rule: dry-run every paid run a goal names). Baseline for the comparison comes from ST-w3jhowin's queue block on kb/public/_census/2026-09-26.csv, filtered to the domain's sources. It runs each step on the model ST-jkehwsu4 and ST-zdfghdlb chose, so its figures are those of the cheapest route that held the bars. 2026-10-11 orchestrator (operator's delegate, unattended run): the paid census of the logs domain (ST-7yh6lbh6 gate g2) is approved within the goal's dry-run-then-cap rule; the item's whole spend stays under 30 USD (a ceiling set without data: when the dry-run estimate exceeds it, stop on a gate). Groups are read with census.py dispatch (claude-sonnet-5-5, ST-zdfghdlb kept it) and the judge on claude-haiku-5-5; BG-tyh3t5oj and BG-l2jdvetp fixed the two dispatch defects ST-zdfghdlb found. No census tag is created and nothing is pushed: the commits stay on work/ST-t67jhly3 for the landing.
